notes: §1985:VI.5.3.4 GR1 requires "The clauses SYNCHRONIZED, PICTURE, JUSTIFIED, and BLANK WHEN ZERO must not be specified except for an elementary data item." Three of the four have no edition arm: CheckPictureRequiredPass.CheckElementaryOnlyClauses walks every entry that has subordinates and refuses a PICTURE (COBOL2191), JUSTIFIED or BLANK WHEN ZERO (COBOL2403) clause it carries (ElementaryOnlyClausesOn reads the three bound facts). SYNCHRONIZED is the 1985 arm: DataBinder.InheritSynchronized visits every group entry and GateSynchronizedGroup asks the construct sync-on-group-2023 for one that wrote the clause, refused below 2023 (COBOL0900 at --std 85). The witness is the refusal of JUSTIFIED RIGHT on a level-01 group; probes at --std 85 refused each of the four clauses on a group at level 01 and at a nested level, in the working-storage, file and linkage sections (SYNCHRONIZED bare, LEFT and RIGHT), and accepted all four on elementary items.

next.reason: 1985: "SYNCHRONIZED, PICTURE, JUSTIFIED, and BLANK WHEN ZERO must not be specified except for an elementary data item"; 2023: "The SYNCHRONIZED clause may be specified for group and elementary items" (§2023:13.18.55.3 SR1). PICTURE, JUSTIFIED and BLANK WHEN ZERO stay elementary-only (§2023:13.16.3 SR11); SYNCHRONIZED on a group item is new.
